mechanism.claim: When minute-by-minute canonical US-dollar returns synchronize across six major FX pairs during the completed liquid session, the move reflects common global-dollar repricing rather than isolated currency news. In an already high-variation BTC regime, BTC relays opposite the completed common dollar direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: opposite the strict sign of the median six-pair canonical-dollar session return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDBR counts same-sign session breadth; DFSR ranks the magnitude of a standardized session-return factor; FVSMR uses directionless cross-pair absolute shocks. HVFXCSR instead ranks the median of fifteen intraday pairwise minute-return correlations. It uses no prior event set or diagnostic control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed pre-entry 24-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse 21:05 UTC weekday macro clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

research_basis.economic_object: cross-market correlation concentration as evidence of a common global shock rather than idiosyncratic currency news
research_basis.selection_boundary: formula, direction, session, ranks, and hold fixed without opening candidate incidence, Gross9 rows, or post-entry BTC outcomes

features.fx_session: bars_polygon interval=1m rows for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDAUD, USDCAD, USDCHF, and USDJPY with 13:00<=UTC time<21:00 on one UTC weekday
features.fx_session_valid: at least 450 distinct observed minutes, first timestamp no later than 13:05, last timestamp no earlier than 20:55, finite positive OHLC; no imputation
features.canonical_minute_returns: negative close-to-close minute log returns for EURUSD and GBPUSD; positive returns for USDAUD, USDCAD, USDCHF, and USDJPY
features.pairwise_correlations: fifteen Pearson correlations on exact common timestamps, each requiring at least 420 finite paired minute returns and positive sample standard deviations
features.fx_synchronization: cross-sectional median of the fifteen finite pairwise correlations
features.synchronization_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 90 prior valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.dollar_direction: strict sign of the median of six canonical session log returns from first to last observed close
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum of squared completed-hour BTC log returns over the 24 hours ending at decision time)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 90 valid decision days, minimum 60; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 21:00 UTC after the FX session and BTC variation are complete
clock.reservation: fixed weekday decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

source_plan.completed_btc: hash-bound completed-hour BTC source through 2026-08-01 for pre-entry variation only
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent intraday FX common-shock synchronization mechanism for volatile BTC regimes

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no correlation, rank, side, hold, clock, session, or subset repair.
